inputs.text: Organizers estimate that 8 million people joined more than 3,300 “No Kings” events across all 50 states, protesting President Donald Trump’s leadership. This is more than a show of opposition: it reflects widespread concern that power is being concentrated at the top, while people most vulnerable to political harm are left to bear the consequences. Defending democracy means protecting those communities, not just preserving institutions on paper. Organizers say turnout exceeded the October demonstrations by about one million participants and 600 events. There’s no official count from US authorities, but the scale of this grassroots mobilization is a powerful signal.

subtopics: Estimated turnout and comparison with October demonstrations
